title: Natural Earth 1:10m bathymetric depth bands
transformations: Burn nested source depth polygons from shallowest to deepest into an 8192×4096 EPSG:4326 grid. Mask bundled country land, then reproject with nearest-neighbour sampling into local indexed PNG tiles. Index 255 is transparent. Colors represent depth intervals, not measured point depths.
limitations: Generalized depth polygons from SRTM Plus, with source cartographic buffering near coasts. Approximately 4.9 km source-grid sampling at the equator; no extra detail when overzoomed. Ridges, shelves, basins and trenches are represented by depth patterns, without individually named feature boundaries or 3D relief.
